In the third route reform, these two routes were split into several sections:

  • Gravies West - Deepond Park: Now to and to . This section was originally planned to have 3 stations, after Deepond South Reclaimation, and station were proposed and merged to Line 4.
  • Deepond Park - : Now to Deepond Lighthouse. This section used to pass station, after East Coast Reef Reclaimation, a new station was proposed and thus adjusted the shape of line. Now passengers needs to transfer at East Coast Road Station to interchange with Line 1 and Line 2.
  • Deepond Light House - Star Pond: Originally section to serve NFC pier.

'''Diamond Bay Depot''' is one of the depots of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and it began services on March 10 2021. It is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent, and this Depot provides services for , and .

Description

Diamond Bay Depot is located at the south peninsula of Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent, and has a total area of 28.3 Hectares.

Depot Structure

Stabling Sidings

This Depot can hold 90 trains, with 35 sidings, 25 tracks 408 m long and 10 tracks 816 m long.

Depot Platforms

This Depot has 2 island platforms, each having Standard Length (204 m). However, they do not feature Platform Screen Doors.

Maintenance Pit

There are four Maintenance Pits.

Cranes and Loading Sidings

This Depot has three piers, featuring loading docks for train loading as maritime exits and entrances.

Connecting Tracks

There are four exits to the north of this depot, two connecting to and two connecting to , and the tracks are also connected to . Trains on have to use tracks to access this depot, but this depot provides direct access to Diamond Pool Station as well.

title: Diamond Pool
safeHtml:
'''Diamond Pool''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Twenty-Second Continent. It is located at the opposite side of Tai Wan Peninsula. Currently, it has been developed as a residential area, and is the most densely populated area in Twenty-Second Continent.

History

In 2017, had plans to build a station in this area called Yodoko. However, due to historical reasons, plans had been abolished.

On December 2019, further development in Twenty-Second continent began, and decided that it wold be easier to begin development at Diamond Pond, which is the only area that provides external road access in Twenty-Second Continent at the time. Therefore, this place is first founded as a residential district consisted of public housing, and this area is renamed Diamond Pond, based on the Route 7 bridge of the same name.

Main Housing Estates

On Ting Estate

On Ting Estate provides 10'880 housing flats in its 17 buildings, and features On Ting Shopping Mall for residential use.

Yau Oi Estate

Yau Oi Estate is located to the coast, and provides 4'080 hosuing flats in its 8 buildings. A bridge is also available for connection to On Ting Estate.

Tin Kung Court

Tin Kung Court is located to the opposite side of On Ting Estate, and provides 2'880 housing flats in its 8 buildlings. However, all its flats have a design of alternate floors, and this led to criticism from its residents. Tin Kung Court may be one of the last housing courts to adopt the "alternate floors" design.

Problems

Despite being home to a population of 30 thousand, On Ting Estate only had 4 basketball courts and two tennis courts. The absence of a Soccer Field also meant that there is a severe recreational facility deficiency in On Ting Estate. However, after the completion of Good Queen Anne Memorial Park between Diamond Pool and Halozy, this porblem may be alleviated. That park features 16 basketball courts, 4 soccier fields, 4 tennis courts, 4 volleyball courts and a Standard Olympic-sized Swimming Pool with a audience stand.

  • Lack of Recreational Facilities

Despite this sub-district having a population of 45 thousand, there are only 5 bus lines providign external access. Most busese are already sautrated upon leaving On Ting Estate Bus Terminus, and rendered passengers waiting at the stations in the middle unable to board. However, May & Lisette, the main bus company, already promised an increase in bus services and more direct routes, and possible footbridges connecting to Kou Fu Sui Station and Inception Bay Station would also be built in the future.

  • Lack of Bus Suppply

While a Primary School and Secondary School are planned for Diamond Pool, they were still under construction by the time all the residents moved into Diamond Pool. As a results, students have to detour to Old Brightland, Downtown and even Sava for studies. This increases transport demand and further worsens traffic problems.。

  • Lack of Student Quotas

Transport

Routes

  • Route 7

Nazca Railway

Despite the existence of the two stations above, Diamond Pool residents are still heavily dependent on Buses for travel to TriPaw and the rest of Los Sengas.
